# Preparation Plan

Plans ordinary document preparation and admission workflows. It initializes process entries, installs destination, embedding and Activation listeners, and arranges readiness refresh and root-source access-loss handling. It snapshots configured template bindings and installs per-party document-access operations accepting one to sixteen initialized Timeline Access publications.

Admission planning delegates to the shared exact Admission Plan Function. The action-definition helper selection uses a bounded canonical function closure only when exact current identities match; a complete custom definition, its extra helpers and constants remain available otherwise. Refresh selection follows the same identity-guarded approach rather than loading an unrelated entire library.

Source-validator planning preserves declared source requirements. The transition validator refuses changing preparation configuration while obligations exist. Plans and emitted access requests describe local work to execute, not proof that a new participant consented, access was delivered or a child became commercially usable.
